elements.title: Forgotten Letters
elements.description: A self-hosted campaign companion for Trench Crusade, one copy per gaming group.

elements.title: app
elements.description: Serves pages, form actions, the JSON API and health checks. On start: migrations (after a dump), the first-owner setup link, background jobs.

elements.title: Web (routes)
elements.description: Pages, form actions and API endpoints. They parse input with zod and call one service; no SQL here.

elements.title: Role areas and account
elements.description: Each role lands in its own area; a header switcher shows every area the person can use.

elements.title: /account
elements.description:
actions: everywhere, name, password
action:everywhere: Sign out of every other device.
  Who: any signed-in person.
  In: nothing.
  Out: { op: 'everywhere', done: true }.
  Errors: 401 unauthenticated.
action:name: Change my display name.
  Who: any signed-in person.
  In: form { displayName }.
  Out: { op: 'name', done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated.
action:password: Change my password; my other devices are signed out.
  Who: any signed-in person.
  In: form { current, password }.
  Out: { op: 'password', done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid (wrong current password, too common, unchanged), 401 unauthenticated.

elements.title: /account/password
elements.description:
actions: default
action:default: Replace a temporary password after a reset; required before anything else.
  Who: a signed-in person whose password was reset.
  In: form { current (the temporary password), password }.
  Out: 303 to the person's own area; their other devices are signed out.
  Errors: 400 invalid (wrong temporary password, too common, unchanged), 401 unauthenticated.

elements.title: /admin
elements.description:
actions: create, resend, revoke
action:create: Create an invite link; Campaign Masters invite users, owners also admins. The link is shown only now.
  Who: admins and owners.
  In: form { role: admin | user, note? }.
  Out: { op: 'create', link }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden role not invitable.
action:resend: Re-send one of my invites: a fresh link with the same role and note; the old link stops working.
  Who: admins (their own invites) and owners.
  In: form { id }.
  Out: { op: 'resend', id, link }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 404 not_found, 409 conflict already used.
action:revoke: Revoke one of my pending invites; its link stops working.
  Who: admins (their own invites) and owners.
  In: form { id }.
  Out: { op: 'revoke', id }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 404 not_found, 409 conflict already used.

elements.title: /owner
elements.description:
actions: anonymise, disable, enable, reset, role
action:anonymise: Anonymise a disabled account: its display name becomes "Former member".
  Who: owners.
  In: form { id, version }.
  Out: { op: 'anonymise', id, done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict not disabled or stale version.
action:disable: Disable an account: it is signed out everywhere and cannot sign in; its history stays.
  Who: owners (never their own account or the last owner).
  In: form { id, version }.
  Out: { op: 'disable', id, done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict last owner, self or stale version.
action:enable: Enable a disabled account again.
  Who: owners.
  In: form { id, version }.
  Out: { op: 'enable', id, done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict stale version.
action:reset: Reset a password to a temporary one, shown once, to be changed at the next sign-in.
  Who: owners.
  In: form { id, version }.
  Out: { op: 'reset', id, done: true, temporary }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict stale version.
action:role: Change a person's role; the last owner can never be demoted.
  Who: owners.
  In: form { id, version, role }.
  Out: { op: 'role', id, done: true }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict last owner or stale version.

elements.title: /owner/backups
elements.description:
actions: restore
action:restore: Restore a backup over the current data; a dump of the current state is written first.
  Who: owners.
  In: form { name } a backup file name from the list.
  Out: { op: 'restore', name, safety } the name of the dump written before restoring.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found no such backup, 500 internal pg_restore failed.

elements.title: /owner/backups/[name]
elements.description:
GET
GET: Download one backup file (audited).
  Who: owners.
  In: path name, a backup file name from the list.
  Out: 200 the dump as application/octet-stream, as an attachment.
  Errors: 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found no such backup.

elements.title: /owner/invites
elements.description:
actions: create, resend, revoke
action:create: Create an invite link for an admin or a user; the link is shown only now.
  Who: owners.
  In: form { role: admin | user, note? }.
  Out: { op: 'create', link }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden.
action:resend: Re-send an invite: a fresh link with the same role and note; the old link stops working.
  Who: owners (any invite).
  In: form { id }.
  Out: { op: 'resend', id, link }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 404 not_found, 409 conflict already used.
action:revoke: Revoke a pending invite; its link stops working.
  Who: owners (any invite).
  In: form { id }.
  Out: { op: 'revoke', id }.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 404 not_found, 409 conflict already used.

elements.title: Sign-in, setup and invite pages
elements.description: The one sign-in screen for every role, the first-owner setup page, and joining by invite.

elements.title: /invite/[token]
elements.description:
actions: default
action:default: Accept an invite: create the account with the invite's role and sign it in.
  Who: anyone holding the invite link.
  In: form { username, displayName, password }.
  Out: 303 to the new account's area with a browser-session cookie.
  Errors: 400 invalid (taken username, common password), 404 not_found unknown or withdrawn invite, 409 conflict used or expired.

elements.title: /login
elements.description:
actions: default
action:default: Sign in with username and password; one form for every role.
  Who: anyone not signed in.
  In: form { username, password, remember? }; query ?next= a local path to return to.
  Out: 303 to `next` or the person's own area, with a session cookie (30 days with remember, else browser session).
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated wrong username or password, 429 rate_limited.

elements.title: /setup/[token]
elements.description:
actions: default
action:default: Create the first owner with the one-time setup link and sign them in.
  Who: anyone holding the setup link printed in the logs, while no owner exists.
  In: form { username, displayName, password }.
  Out: 303 to /owner with a remembered session cookie.
  Errors: 400 invalid (taken username, common password), 409 conflict link used or expired or an owner exists.

elements.title: /logout
elements.description:
actions: default · layout
action:default: Sign out of this device.
  Who: anyone; a visitor without a session is simply sent to sign in.
  In: nothing.
  Out: 303 to /login, the session ended and its cookie cleared.
  Errors: none.

elements.title: JSON API v1
elements.description: The same actions as the pages, authenticated by the session cookie; documented by an OpenAPI document.

elements.title: /api/v1/audit
elements.description:
GET
GET: The audit log, newest first, optionally one action.
  Who: owners.
  In: query ?before=<id>&limit=<1..100, default 50>&action=<name>
  Out: 200 { items: AuditEntry[], next }
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden not an owner.

elements.title: /api/v1/auth/login
elements.description:
POST
POST: Sign in with username and password.
  Who: anyone.
  In: { username, password, remember? }
  Out: 200 { user } and a session cookie.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated wrong username or password, 403 forbidden other site, 429 rate_limited.

elements.title: /api/v1/auth/logout
elements.description:
POST
POST: Sign out on this device.
  Who: any signed-in account.
  In: nothing.
  Out: 204 and the session cookie cleared.
  Errors: 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden other site.

elements.title: /api/v1/auth/logout-everywhere
elements.description:
POST
POST: Sign out every other device; this one stays signed in.
  Who: any signed-in account.
  In: nothing.
  Out: 204.
  Errors: 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden other site.

elements.title: /api/v1/invites
elements.description:
GET POST
GET: Pending invites.
  Who: owners (all) and admins (their own).
  In: nothing.
  Out: 200 { items: Invite[] }
  Errors: 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden for users.
POST: Create an invite link; the link is shown only now.
  Who: owners (admin or user invites) and admins (user invites).
  In: { role, note? }
  Out: 201 { invite, link }
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden role not invitable or other site.

elements.title: /api/v1/invites/[id]
elements.description:
DELETE
DELETE: Withdraw an invite; its link stops working.
  Who: owners (any invite) and admins (their own).
  In: path id.
  Out: 204.
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden other site, 404 not_found, 409 conflict already used.

elements.title: /api/v1/invites/[id]/resend
elements.description:
POST
POST: Replace an invite with a fresh link for the same role and note; the old link stops working.
  Who: owners (any invite) and admins (their own).
  In: path id.
  Out: 201 { invite, link }
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden other site, 404 not_found, 409 conflict already used.

elements.title: /api/v1/invites/token/[token]
elements.description:
GET
GET: What an invite link offers: its state, role, note, inviter and expiry.
  Who: anyone holding the link.
  In: path token.
  Out: 200 { state, role, note, inviter, expiresAt }
  Errors: 400 invalid, 404 not_found unknown link.

elements.title: /api/v1/invites/token/[token]/accept
elements.description:
POST
POST: Accept an invite: create the account and sign it in.
  Who: anyone holding the invite link.
  In: path token; { username, displayName, password }
  Out: 201 { user } and a session cookie.
  Errors: 400 invalid username taken or weak password, 403 forbidden other site, 404 not_found unknown or withdrawn invite, 409 conflict used or expired.

elements.title: /api/v1/me
elements.description:
GET PATCH
GET: The signed-in account and the areas it may use.
  Who: any signed-in account.
  In: nothing.
  Out: 200 { user, areas }
  Errors: 401 unauthenticated.
PATCH: Change the display name.
  Who: any signed-in account, for itself.
  In: { displayName }
  Out: 200 { user }
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden other site.

elements.title: /api/v1/me/password
elements.description:
POST
POST: Change the password; every other device is signed out.
  Who: any signed-in account, for itself.
  In: { current, password }
  Out: 204.
  Errors: 400 invalid wrong current, common or unchanged password, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden other site.

elements.title: /api/v1/openapi.json
elements.description:
GET
GET: The OpenAPI 3.1 document for this API.
  Who: anyone.
  In: nothing.
  Out: 200 the OpenAPI document.
  Errors: none beyond 500 internal.

elements.title: /api/v1/users
elements.description:
GET
GET: A page of people, oldest first.
  Who: owners (everyone) and admins (the people they invited).
  In: query ?after=<id>&limit=<1..100, default 50>
  Out: 200 { items: Person[], next }
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden for users.

elements.title: /api/v1/users/[id]
elements.description:
PATCH
PATCH: Change an account's role and/or disable or enable it.
  Who: owners.
  In: path id; { role?, disabled?, version }
  Out: 200 Person
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden not an owner or other site, 404 not_found, 409 conflict stale version, last owner or own account.

elements.title: /api/v1/users/[id]/anonymise
elements.description:
POST
POST: Anonymise a disabled account: its display name becomes "Former member".
  Who: owners.
  In: path id; { version }
  Out: 200 Person
  Errors: 400 invalid, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden not an owner or other site, 404 not_found, 409 conflict stale version or not disabled.

elements.description: Liveness for Docker; readiness (database and migrations) for proxies and smoke tests.

elements.title: /health/live
elements.description:
GET
GET: Liveness: the process is up and answering. No database call.
  Who: anyone (Docker's healthcheck).
  Out: 200 { status: "ok" }.

elements.title: /health/ready
elements.description:
GET
GET: Readiness: the database answers and every migration is applied.
  Who: anyone (Caddy, the CI smoke test, people); version details only for a signed-in owner.
  Out: 200 { status: "ready", database: true, migrated: true } or 503 with the same fields.
  Errors: 503 while starting, after SIGTERM, or when the database is down.

views.title: First start: migrations, backup, the first owner
views.description:
**A group installs the app and becomes its owner without editing passwords into files.**

**Decisions**
- Before any pending migration runs, the app writes a pg_dump to the backups volume (forward-only migrations;
  the dump is the undo). Migrations run in one transaction under an advisory lock; a failure stops the app.
- While no owner exists, the app logs a one-time setup link (random token, only its hash stored, one hour,
  single use). Visiting it creates the first owner and signs them in.
- /health/ready answers 503 until migrations are applied; /health/live answers as soon as the process runs.

steps.label: no owner: log a setup link

views.title: Invite and join
views.description:
**Nobody registers alone: an owner or admin sends a link that fixes the role.**

**Decisions**
- Owners invite admins and users; admins invite users; users cannot invite.
- An invite is valid for 7 days and works once; only its token hash is stored. The inviter sees pending
  invites and can revoke or re-send (a new link) them.
- Accepting creates the account and signs it in, in one transaction with a row lock, so two people accepting
  the same link at once make exactly one account.

steps.label: lock invite, insert user, mark used

views.title: Managing people
views.description:
**The owner keeps the group's accounts in order without email.**

**Decisions**
- Owners see every account; admins see the users they invited.
- Changing a role or disabling an account never removes the last owner.
- Disabling ends every session at once; history stays.
- A password reset sets a readable temporary password that must be changed at the next sign-in.
- A disabled account can be anonymised: its display name becomes "Former member".
- Every change is written to the audit log in the same transaction.

views.title: Failure and recovery
views.description:
**A group without an ops person can see what is wrong and get back on its feet.**

**Decisions**
- A bad .env stops the app at start and names the setting (never its secret value).
- If the database is down, /health/ready answers 503, pages say so clearly, and the pool reconnects with
  backoff on its own.
- Every response carries X-Request-Id; errors use one shape with the request id.
- The owner downloads a backup or restores one from the owner area; the app warns when served over plain HTTP.
- A locked-out owner is recovered with a documented docker compose exec command.

views.title: Sessions and the account page
views.description:
**Everyone controls their own sign-in.**

**Decisions**
- Every request resolves the cookie to a session and user; disabled accounts and expired sessions are
  rejected. A session in use slides forward about once a day.
- Everyone can change their display name and password and sign out of every device.
- An hourly job (one runner at a time, by advisory lock) removes expired sessions, invites and setup tokens,
  and prunes audit entries older than the retention period (180 days).

views.title: Sign-in: one screen for every role
views.description:
**Owners, admins and users sign in on the same screen and land in their own area.**

**Decisions**
- Five tries a minute per username and per address (in memory); then "Too many tries".
- A wrong password and an unknown username get the same message; the hash check runs for unknown names too.
- The session token is 32 random bytes in an httpOnly, SameSite=Lax cookie (Secure over HTTPS); only its
  SHA-256 is stored. "Remember me": 30 days, extended by use; otherwise a browser session.
- Owner lands on /owner, Admin on /admin, User on /home; a required password change goes to
  /account/password first. Every sign-in is written to the audit log.
